{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any invalid values in customer_age
# The minimum age is -1, which is implausible
invalid_age_mask = sales_df['customer_age'] < 0
invalid_age_count = invalid_age_mask.sum()

# Show the rows with invalid age
invalid_rows = sales_df[invalid_age_mask]

invalid_age_count, invalid_rows"}
